desktop.connect.hint: Don't have an instance yet? LobbyForge is self-hosted: run it on your own machine with Docker, or ask your community's admin for the address.
desktop.connect.label: Instance address
desktop.connect.subtitle: Connect to your self-hosted LobbyForge instance to join voice rooms and live activities.
desktop.error.failed: Could not connect. Check the address and try again.
desktop.error.httpsRequired: The address must start with https://.
desktop.error.noExtras: Use the address only: no user name, password, query or # part.
desktop.error.originOnly: Use the address only, without a path (for example https://chat.example.com).
